title: 25% or 17%: the new US 'excess capacity' tariff on India, explained
short: 25% or 17%: the new US 'overcapacity' tariff on India
dek: Washington has proposed tariffs of 15% to 35% on 14 economies it accuses of building too many factories. India's rate is up to 25%, or 17% if a trade deal is signed. India says it has no excess capacity in any sector.
card: The US wants up to 25% on Indian goods over 'excess capacity', cut to 17% with a trade deal. What it covers and what comes next.
